name: returning_customer_remembered
description: Returning customer says 'Hi, I'm back' and the AI should remember them from the earlier interaction, referencing prior context.

messages.text: My name is James, can I get a quote for 15 sheets of black melamine chipboard 18mm

expected_behaviors.description: AI should remember and address the customer as 'James'

notes: Verifies that the AI retains context across a short delay and welcomes the customer back by name, demonstrating memory of the earlier quote request.
